2 - Superintendent Of Police Distt. Korba, Sp Office, Korba District Korba (C.G.) 3 - Station House Officer P.S.Hardibazar District Korba (C.G.) 4 - Jyoti Sahu D/o Firatram Sahu Aged About 25 Years R/o Bajar Dafayi Surakchhar P.S. Kusmunda,
Teh Katghora, Distt. Korba (C.G.)
---- Respondents Order Sheet 04/12/2024 Heard Mr. Anil Tripathi, learned counsel for the petitioners in both the petitions.
Also heard Mr. S.S. Baghel, learned Dy. Government Advocate appearing for the State/respondent.

It has been argued by learned counsel for the petitioner that the matter was referred to the Mediation Center of this Court vide order dated 04.11.2024, and as per report of the Mediation Center dated 26.11.2024, the mediation between the parties has been reported to be 'Non Starter' as the private respondent could not appear.
In view of the same, let notices be issued to the respondents No.4 on payment of process fee, as per rules.
Learned State counsel shall inform about the pendency of the present petition to the respondents who shall appear in person or their counsel for consideration of the prayer made in the petition.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings in relation to the FIR registered in Crime No.0210/2024 dated 10.09.2024 for offence under Sections 498A, 34 of the IPC in WPCR No. 425 of 2024 and the FIR registered in Crime No.0172/2024 dated 24.06.2024 for offence under Sections 509-B of the IPC in WPCR No. 438 of 2024 at Police Station Hardibazar, District Korba against the petitioners, shall remain stayed.
List the matter after two weeks.
